name: Camping am Moserhof
beschreibung: The Camping am Moserhof is located in the municipality of Samerberg in the district of Kufstein, Tyrol. The site is surrounded by meadows and forests, offering a peaceful atmosphere. The facilities include powered pitches, modern sanitary amenities, a restaurant, and a playground. The area is dominated by the Kaisergebirge and the Chiemgau Alps. Guests have access to a network of hiking and cycling trails. In winter, the ski resorts of Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser and Alpbachtal are reachable by car. The campsite serves as a starting point for trips into the Inn Valley.
